summary: Veris Residential filed an 8-K reporting stockholder lawsuits challenging its going-private merger. The company entered into a Merger Agreement on February 23, 2026, with AC Residential Acquisition LP (Parent) and affiliates, whereby Veris will merge with Merger Sub I and its operating partnership will merge with Merger Sub II. Special stockholder meeting is set for May 21, 2026. Three complaints filed in NY and NJ state courts allege inadequate disclosures in the definitive proxy statement, naming the company, board, and certain advisors. No specific deal price, premium, or advisor names are disclosed in this filing. Watch for potential settlement disclosures or injunction motions that could delay the shareholder vote and consummation of the merger.
